description: Four-panel summary of the IpaH4.5 RabGAP plausibility analysis
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15,8.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,3, height_ratios=[1.0,1.25], hspace=0.45, wspace=0.3)

# ---- A: shape metrics (computed above) ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
ents=["IpaH4.5\nLRR 26-287","IpaH4.5\nNEL 295-574","Gyp1 TBC\n2G77_A"]
ratio=[9.1,2.8,3.1]; maxd=[76.1,65.4,60.0]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2, ratio, w, color="#2980b9", label="principal axis ratio")
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.bar(x+w/2, maxd, w, color="#bdc3c7", label="max dimension (A)")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(ents, fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("principal axis ratio", color="#2980b9"); ax2.set_ylabel("max dimension (A)")
ax.set_title("LRR is an elongated solenoid,\nthe TBC domain is globular", fontsize=10)

# ---- B: exhaustive TBC audit ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
regs=["1-60","26-287\nLRR","280-305\nlinker","295-430\nNEL a","420-574\nNEL b","1-574\nfull"]
tot=[40,1212,0,10,21,206]; tbc=[0,0,0,0,0,0]
x=np.arange(len(regs))
ax.bar(x, tot, color="#95a5a6", label="alignments returned")
ax.bar(x, tbc, color="#c0392b", label="TBC / RabGAP hits")
ax.set_yscale("symlog"); ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(regs, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Foldseek alignments (log)")
ax.set_title("1489 alignments over the whole chain,\nzero TBC or RabGAP hits", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7)

# ---- C: motif-pair distance vs measured transition-state references ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
pairs=["R429-Q567","R429-Q531","R433-Q531","R433-Q567","R41-Q146","R433-Q146","R429-Q146","R41-Q567","R41-Q531"]
dist=[30.1,33.4,34.0,34.1,41.4,50.3,53.4,115.3,120.8]
ax.barh(pairs[::-1], dist[::-1], color="#7f8fa6")
ax.axvline(3.75, color="#c0392b", lw=2, label="Gyp1 R343-Q378 = 3.8 A")
ax.axvline(4.25, color="#e67e22", lw=2, ls="--", label="VirA R188-Q280 = 4.3 A")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("Arg-Gln side-chain tip distance (A, log)")
ax.set_title("Motif-derived fingers never converge", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right"); ax.tick_params(labelsize=7.5)

# ---- D: domain map with candidate residues and paralog conservation ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
L=574
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.42),L,0.16, color="#ecf0f1", ec="k", lw=0.5))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((4,0.42),287-4,0.16, color="#5dade2", ec="k", lw=0.5))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((295,0.42),574-295,0.16, color="#f0b27a", ec="k", lw=0.5))
ax.text(145,0.50,"LRR 4-287 (ribonuclease-inhibitor-like, CATH 3.80.10.10)",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.text(435,0.50,"NEL 295-574 (IPR029487)",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.text(291,0.65,"linker\n285-292",ha="center",fontsize=6.5)
marks=[(41,"R41\n2/12","#7f8c8d"),(146,"Q146\n2/12","#7f8c8d"),(379,"C379\n12/12","#27ae60"),
       (429,"R429\n12/12","#2980b9"),(433,"R433\n12/12","#2980b9"),
       (531,"Q531\n12/12","#2980b9"),(567,"Q567\n12/12","#2980b9")]
for p,lab,c in marks:
    ax.plot([p,p],[0.40,0.30],color=c,lw=1.6)
    ax.plot(p,0.42,marker="v",color=c,ms=7)
    ax.text(p,0.26,lab,ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,color=c)
ax.text(5,0.78,"Candidate TBC-like fingers (grey = variable across IpaH paralogs, blue = invariant 12/12, green = NEL catalytic Cys)",
        fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(-10,L+10); ax.set_ylim(0.05,0.9); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("IpaH4.5 residue (P18009)")
ax.set_title("No region of IpaH4.5 is unassigned; the invariant candidate fingers sit inside the NEL fold", fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
